CustomerOtp.//: Customer verification codes (activation, password reset, number change). Provider: 'TwilioSms' in production (uses Twilio:AccountSid/AuthToken plus Sms:MessagingServiceSid or Sms:From); unset = disabled (nothing is sent). Limits default to: 6-digit code, 10 min expiry, 5 attempts, 60 s resend cooldown, 5 codes/hour, 15 min verification token.

Twilio.//: Never put real credentials in this file. Supply them per environment via environment variables (Twilio__AccountSid, Twilio__AuthToken, Twilio__WhatsAppFrom, Twilio__MessagingServiceSid) or user-secrets. See docs/APPOINTMENT-REMINDERS-SPECIFICATION.md for the sandbox and production setup.
